title: Zariski inverse image injects into the etale inverse image (sheaves of sets)
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $i:Z\to X$ a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] and $F$ a sheaf of sets on the small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Let $F_{\rm Zar}$ be the sheaf of sets $W\mapsto F(W\hookrightarrow X)$ on the topological space of $X$ ($W\subseteq X$ open) [lem-weil-pbc-zariski-etale-inclusion-morphism-of-sites], and let $i^{-1}_{\rm Zar}F_{\rm Zar}$ be its topological inverse image on $Z$ with unit $\eta^{\rm Zar}_W:F_{\rm Zar}(W)\to(i^{-1}_{\rm Zar}F_{\rm Zar})(i^{-1}W)$ [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] (2), (3) with values in sets. Let $i^{-1}F$ be the etale inverse image of $F$, a sheaf of sets on $Z_{\Et}$ (the sheafification of $V\mapsto\varinjlim_{(U,\varphi)}F(U)$ over pairs of $U$ etale over $X$ and a $Z$-morphism $\varphi:V\to U\times_XZ$ [def-pc-fibre-product], as in [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-functor-sheaf-pullback-adjunction] (2) for the functor $U\mapsto U\times_XZ$, i.e. [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] with values in sets), with unit $i^*:F(U)\to(i^{-1}F)(U\times_XZ)$, and let $(i^{-1}F)_{\rm Zar}$ be the sheaf $V\mapsto(i^{-1}F)(V\hookrightarrow Z)$ on the topological space of $Z$. For $W\subseteq X$ open identify $W\times_XZ$ with the open subscheme $i^{-1}(W)$ of $Z$. Then there is exactly one morphism of sheaves of sets $\beta:i^{-1}_{\rm Zar}F_{\rm Zar}\to(i^{-1}F)_{\rm Zar}$ on $Z$ with $\beta_{i^{-1}W}(\eta^{\rm Zar}_W(s))=i^*s$ for every open $W\subseteq X$ and every $s\in F(W)$, and $\beta_V$ is injective for every open $V\subseteq Z$. In particular the canonical restriction $\Gamma(X,F)\to\Gamma(Z,i^{-1}F)$, $s\mapsto i^*s$, is the composite of $\eta^{\rm Zar}_X:\Gamma(X,F_{\rm Zar})=F(X)\to\Gamma(Z,i^{-1}_{\rm Zar}F_{\rm Zar})$ with the injective map $\beta_Z$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 09ZF (lemma-gabber-h0), proof, first paragraph ('There is a canonical (base change) map ... we obtain injectivity on stalks') and second paragraph (factorization of the restriction map)

proof.text: Construct alpha from the transported etale unit by the proved naturality lemma. Apply the topological inverse-image adjunction hom equivalence to alpha to define beta. The hom-equivalence unit formula gives the stated component equation.

Apply the stalk-injectivity lemma to beta and its unit equation. To prove sectionwise injectivity, fix two sections with equal images and a point of their open. Their images in the neighbourhood colimit are equal by colimit.ι_map, hence their original colimit classes are equal by stalk injectivity. Filtered-colimit equality supplies a smaller neighbourhood on which the original restrictions agree. Choose these neighbourhoods for every point; they cover the given open. Sheaf separation (Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq') proves equality of the sections, including the empty-open case.

For any beta prime satisfying the equation, its adjunction transpose and alpha agree componentwise on every section, hence agree as sheaf morphisms. Injectivity of the hom equivalence gives beta prime = beta. Conversely substitute beta and use the equation already proved. Taking the top open specializes that equation to the global-section factorization.

split_report.summary: Split following the first paragraph of the proof of Stacks 09ZF (and the factorization of its second paragraph) in six steps: (1) the base change map beta built by the adjunction i^{-1}_Zar -| i_* from the unit s |-> i^*s of the etale inverse image, with its uniqueness; (2) the unit written as theta of the coprojection at (U,id) of the presheaf inverse image, and filteredness of the index categories; (3) the source's key argument: equality of i^*a, i^*b near z gives, through local agreement in the sheafification, a pair (U,psi) with a|_U=b|_U and U over i(z); the image U_0 of U is open and U -> U_0 is an etale covering, so a=b on U_0; (4) injectivity of beta on stalks from the stalk bijection of the topological inverse image; (5) injectivity on sections from germs; (6) the factorization on global sections. The source's description of the right-hand stalk ('colimit over elementary etale neighbourhoods (U,u) such that U x_X Z -> Z has a section near z') is not used as a statement: step 3 works with representatives directly, which is what the source's argument needs. All cited nodes exist; no new node was created. Statement unchanged.
